title: Context Quality Matters in Training Fusion-in-Decoder for Extractive Open-Domain Question Answering
authors: Kosuke Akimoto; Kunihiro Takeoka; Masafumi Oyamada
why_relevant: Analyzes how context quality (proportion of relevant vs irrelevant passages) during FiD training affects robustness at inference, and proposes a cross-attention bias method to mitigate overfitting to specific context quality.
why_not_or_caveat: Focuses on FiD-specific training dynamics rather than general LLM RAG robustness.
suggested_section: Noisy retrieval and training under irrelevant passages
